blind.description: A low, circular metal brazier / fire bowl resting on four splayed legs reinforced with horizontal crossbars and rivets. The bowl rim is banded with metal fittings and features four hanging ring handles. Inside, the shallow bowl is filled with light grey ash and dark charcoal chunks / unlit coals. The metal has an aged, tarnished bronze or brass finish with slight edge highlights. All surfaces are solid, continuous, and manifold with clean stylized geometry; no detached floating parts or melted mesh artifacts.
blind.from_above: A circular bowl with a thick metal rim decorated by four evenly spaced clasps with hanging ring handles, filled with grey ash bed dotted with dark charcoal briquettes or coals.
blind.height_vs_figure: About knee-high to the figure, roughly 1.5 to 2 feet tall, and about 2.5 to 3 feet in diameter across the rim.

notes: height is slightly squatter than catalog ratio but matches requested low stand
